tasks.title: Range step
tasks.solution: CHANNEL_VALUE_TO_STEP: step = (v − 900) / 25 with the fractional part dropped (before that the value is constrained to 900…2100).

tasks.title: What the CLI reads back
tasks.solution: The step number is stored, and MODE_STEP_TO_CHANNEL_VALUE = 900 + 25 · step is printed back. The boundary is rounded down to a multiple of 25.

tasks.title: The value after a hold
tasks.solution: The number of steps is n = 1 + ⌊T / 0.5⌋: the first at the moment of the press, then once every 500 ms. Value = min(2000, v0 + 10·n): at the limit the number stands still while the beeper keeps beeping.

tasks.title: How long to hold the switch
tasks.solution: You need k steps. The first happens at once, the other k − 1 with a period of 0.5 s: T = (k − 1) · 0.5 s. Short presses with a return to center are faster.

tasks.title: Time to the limit
tasks.solution: The channel is below 1300 — a step of −1 at once and then once every 500 ms. Reaching zero takes d steps: (d − 1) · 0.5 s. That is why a self-centering switch is used on the adjustment channel.
